d.j: The user makes a suggestive comment about the other person's body.
The user is making a suggestive request to see more.

d.seg: Hum WhatsApp wagera pe bhi woh karte hain.
d.tr: We also do that on WhatsApp and such.
d.j: The user suggests moving the conversation to an external platform (WhatsApp).
The user explicitly asks for the other person's WhatsApp contact details.

d.seg: WhatsApp pe toh de doongi sir, WhatsApp pe payment daalna padega aapko.
d.tr: I will give it on WhatsApp sir, you will have to make a payment on WhatsApp.
d.j: The user is explicitly linking payment to a service on an external platform.
The user specifies a rate for the service.
